title: Reproducible qualification plan for a local native ZAFF4 field
summary: Bind frozen inputs and a finite candidate policy to a reproducible plan. This planning operation starts no jobs and grants no physical or spectral qualification.
gates: Development draft; not activated in the default KEYMAKER catalog and not a qualified production protocol
Freeze electronic state, atom order, masses, internal gauge, harmonic parent, CM5/nonbonded parent and source derivative provenance
Missing internal parameters start at zero; missing modal observations never become zero observations
No independent four-distinct internal quartics; retain induced four-distinct modal entries and the full coordinate transformation
Negative fourth derivatives are permitted; completion preserves the chosen fitted jet through order four
Local fit tolerances and observed residuals must be supplied separately; derivative residuals are not frequency errors
Fit first, complete asymptotics, screen coupled minima, transform and solve spectra, then assess significance and prune with complete requalification
No external electronic points, no QM keyword changes; angular boundary and dihedral periodicity conditions remain separately identified
Finite family/radius catalogs, thresholds, seeds, resource limits and exact code/input hashes are frozen before candidate execution
Every plateau member must independently pass minima checks; stronger damping is not assumed to preserve that property
Grid, box, basis, all-mode/active-space and occupied-domain controls must pass before a spectral plateau is accepted
Only qualified corresponding levels enter plateau comparisons; boundary-localized states of an unstable local potential are not reference spectra
Reserved independent starts confirm the final candidate and neighbours; finite searches never prove global absence of minima
No candidate or no spectral plateau yields an explicit unqualified result, never automatic tolerance relaxation
Planning qualification, local low-level qualification, high-energy domain qualification and rate qualification are separate statuses
Validate the same policy on S0 and T1 and on a second molecule before marking the general protocol approved
coordinate_policy: Exact source and target frames are hashed. Frozen internal initial closure is distinct from missing modal observations. Native periodic functions and defining bond switches are retained.
backend_policy: Plan only; later numerical work requires the explicitly declared remote host and 128 GiB per process. Current owner building blocks perform fits, protected completion and finite spectral controls separately.
